name: Noir
summary: A 1940s detective story in hard light and venetian-blind shadow: Acme Pulse reads every file overnight, circles the clue in coral, and hands the human the call at dawn.
look: High-contrast monochrome with no fill light, skewed blind shadows, a swinging lamp, film grain and gate weave. The only colour is coral, drawn around the clue and on the decision; the end card opens the blinds into warm daylight and brand teal.

components.name: Blind gobo
components.role: skewed repeating-linear-gradient stripes; the signature light pattern

components.name: Hard spotlight
components.role: radial mask with no fill light; decides what the viewer can see

components.name: Case files
components.role: stacked folders typed 'DASHBOARD 38 — UNREAD'; the pain as a pile

components.name: Frosted door
components.role: backlit glass lettering with the Acme mark; the reveal as a detective agency

components.name: Evidence board
components.role: exhibits, cleared suspects, pins and a coral string; the only colour is the clue

components.name: Typed memo
components.role: 'Your call, boss.' with Roll back / Acknowledge; the human decision

motion.name: Blind tilt
motion.how: stripes rotate 4° and change thickness, power1.inOut 1.5 s, starting on bar downbeats

motion.name: Light swing
motion.how: lamp spotlight sways ±6° on a 3 s sine (1.5 bars at 120 BPM)

motion.name: Gate weave
motion.how: whole-frame 0.5 px jitter from a seeded table plus grain stepped at 24 fps

story: Hook: blind shadows slice across a pile of unread dashboard case files: 'And the drop still shipped on Friday.' Reveal: on the drop a light snaps on behind a frosted door lettered with the Acme mark, 'Acme Pulse · Anomaly investigations · Open all night'. Proof: on the evidence board p95 and error rate are cleared, a coral circle marks the checkout drop, Exhibit A reads 'Checkout conversion −18% since 09:42', a coral string runs to Exhibit B 'deploy #2231', and a memo says 'Your call, boss.' with Roll back. CTA: the blinds open into daylight; 'You ship. Pulse watches.', Start free, 'Case closed · 6 min'.
adapt: Pin your own screens as exhibits, grey out what your product clears, and draw the coral string from the finding to its root cause.

references.note: video essay on venetian-blind shadows in cinema

fit.risk: Noir implies crime and fraud; frame it as a mistake hunt, never wrongdoing, and end in bright daylight.
